whisper.definition: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

whispered.definition: Form of whisper (participle past): To speak softly or under one's breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter words without sonant breath; to talk without that vibration of the vocal cords which gives so.

whispering.definition: Something that is whispered; gossip; a rumor.

whistle.definition: To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and lips.

whistles.definition: Form of whistle (indicative present singular third-person): To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

white-haired.definition: Having white hair; especially, of a person, from old age.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

whooped.definition: Form of whoop (participle past): To make a whoop.

whooping.definition: Form of whoop (gerund participle present): To make a whoop.

who’s.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wide.definition: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widely.definition: In a wide manner; across a wide area.

widespread.definition: Affecting, or found throughout, a large area (e.g. the entire land or body); broad in extent; widely diffused.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wilderness.definition: Uncultivated and unsettled land in its natural state inhabited by wild animals and with vegetation growing wild; (countable) a tract of such land; a waste or wild.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

windows.definition: Form of window (plural): An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

winds.definition: Form of wind (plural): Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wiped.definition: Form of wipe (participle past): To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

wire.definition: To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

wire’s.definition: To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

wiring.definition: Form of wire (gerund participle present): To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wiser.definition: Form of wise (comparative): Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wished.definition: Form of wish (participle past): To desire; to want.

wishes.definition: Form of wish (indicative present singular third-person): To desire; to want.

wishing.definition: Form of wish (gerund participle present): To desire; to want.

wisps.definition: Form of wisp (plural): A small bundle, as of straw or other like substance; a twisted handful of something; any slender, flexible structure or group.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

woke.definition: Form of wake (past): (often followed by up) To stop sleeping.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wondered.definition: Form of wonder (participle past): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workroom.definition: A room, such as a workshop or studio, where work is done.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workshop.definition: A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worn-out.definition: Damaged due to continued or hard exposure or use until no longer effective or useful.

worried.definition: Form of worry (participle past): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worries.definition: Form of worry (indicative present singular third-person): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worry.definition: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worrying.definition: Form of worry (gerund participle present): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wrapped.definition: Form of wrap (participle past): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wreckage.definition: Something wrecked, especially the remains or debris of something which has been severely damaged or destroyed.

wriggled.definition: Form of wriggle (participle past): To twist one's body to and fro with short, writhing motions; to squirm.

wrinkles.definition: Form of wrinkle (plural): A small furrow, ridge or crease in an otherwise smooth surface.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

writ.definition: A written order, issued by a court, ordering someone to do (or stop doing) something.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writs.definition: Form of writ (plural): A written order, issued by a court, ordering someone to do (or stop doing) something.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

xeno-psychologist.definition: An expert in the field of xenopsychology.

yacht.definition: A slick and light ship for making pleasure trips or racing on water, having sails but often motor-powered. At times used as a residence offshore on a dock.

yakking.definition: Form of yak (gerund participle present): To talk, particularly informally but persistently; to chatter or prattle.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

yeah.definition: Form of year (colloquial pronunciation-spelling): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year’s.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellowed.definition: Form of yellow (participle past): To become yellow or yellower.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zag.definition: One of a series of sharp turns or reversals.

zarathustran.definition: Form of zarathustrian (alternative not-comparable): Relating to or characteristic of Zarathustrianism (also known as Zoroastrianism).

zeno.definition: Requiring or involving an infinite number of intervals within a finite time.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zipped.definition: Form of zip (participle past): To close with a zip fastener.

zones.definition: Form of zone (plural): Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the pol.

zoologist.definition: One who studies or practices zoology.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
